summary: Add explicit instructions to prevent premature task completion without executing changes

edits.hypothesis: Adding explicit guardrails in the prompt template prevents the agent from declaring task completion after only exploring repository history without executing necessary commands.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose prompt instruction directly guides policy behavior regarding task lifecycle decisions.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) fix-git would have received explicit reminder to run merge/checkout before completing; (preservative) does not restrict valid inspection or execution habits; (transfer) generalizes to any task where an agent might mistake exploration for resolution.
edits.mechanism: Adding explicit guardrails in the prompt template prevents the agent from declaring task completion after only exploring repository history without executing necessary commands.
